attempts.summary: Installed a root crontab entry on node1 to run /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance daily at 02:15, appending stdout/stderr to /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log. Verified cron.service active and the job executes correctly. Performed mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id and healthy state, rebooted node1 via `shutdown -r now`, confirmed connection dropped then recovered, verified changed boot_id proving an actual restart, and confirmed post-restart recovery of cron.service, the crontab entry, and the log file (including a fresh successful manual run appending to it).
